# govault Provider

Configure the GoVault provider with token bootstrap, verified TLS, and server-derived namespace authority.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.10.0"

  required_providers {
    govault = {
      source = "desatatufuria/govault"
    }
  }
}

provider "govault" {
  address      = "https://govault.example.com"
  auth_method  = "token"
  token_env    = "GOVAULT_TOKEN"
  ca_cert_file = "/etc/govault/ca.pem"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Base HTTPS address of the GoVault API.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method. Phase E supports only token bootstrap.

### Optional

- `ca_cert_file` (String) Optional path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate file used to verify GoVault.
- `token_env` (String) Name of the environment variable that will supply the GoVault token. This is a selector, not the token value.
